query: I just tried the new matcha croissant from the bakery down the street this morning, it’s so buttery and the matcha filling isn’t too sweet at all, I even bought an extra one to save for tomorrow. Also my cat figured out how to open the kitchen cabinet last night, he dragged out a whole bag of treats and ate half of it, I had to rush to the vet to make sure he was okay, he’s totally fine now just a little grumpy I took the rest of the treats away. Oh right, I’m actually calling because my mobile data isn’t working at all right now. I’m abroad right now and I have roaming turned off, and my network connection is super bad, I can’t load any pages or send messages at all, can you help me figure out what’s going on?
